verdict.rationale: Brex is an expense-management product, so mileage and per-diem claims are a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions mileage logging, map-based distance calculation, or per-diem rates. Related items such as AI assistants filing reimbursements, stipend limits, and receipt matching are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an employee, I can log mileage with map-based distance and claim per-diem rates without building the expense by hand
